verdict_text:
NO

The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, but the specification's "Required result" clause requires removing head 5 from every layer. Consequently the fused `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` drop rows `4608..5375` instead of the required `3840..4607` (clauses 1 and 2), and `attention.dense.weight` drops columns `1536..1791` instead of the required `1280..1535` (clause 3). The shapes are all correct, so the four required checks pass and the error is silent; grading is bit-exact against a reference, so every one of the 48 modified tensors will mismatch in value. Everything else — layout handling (768-row interleaved head blocks, column blocks of 256 in `dense.weight`), the untouched tensors, the 244-tensor count, and the output path — matches the specification.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
